item.title: Naval Health Clinic Oak Harbor expands pharmacy access with Q-Anywhere and ScriptCenter
item.description: Naval Health Clinic Oak Harbor is improving pharmacy access for beneficiaries through the combined use of the Q-Anywhere text notification system and ScriptCenter prescription pickup kiosk, streamlining the refill and pickup process while reducing wait times inside the clinic.

item.title: Photo Story: February 2026 construction operations for fiscal year 2024-funded $55.75 million Collective Training Officers Quarters Project at Fort McCoy, Part 3
item.description: Contractors complete work Feb. 26, 2026, for the fiscal year 2024-funded $55.75 million Collective Training Officers Quarters Project at Fort McCoy, Wis.

item.title: Oak Harbor Navy medical staff train to deliver lifesaving care in combat environments
item.description: Medical personnel at Navy Medicine Readiness and Training Command Oak Harbor(NMRTCOH) recently completed training associated with advanced Tactical Combat Casualty Care (TCCC) training aimed at strengthening both day-to-day patient care and readiness for potential operational deployments.

item.title: Photo Story: February 2026 construction operations for fiscal year 2024-funded $55.75 million Collective Training Officers Quarters Project at Fort McCoy, Part 4
item.description: The construction area for the fiscal year 2024-funded $55.75 million Collective Training Officers Quarters Project is shown Feb. 26, 2026, at sunset at Fort McCoy, Wis.

item.title: THUNDERBIRDS EARN FINAL CERTIFICATION FOR 2026 SHOW SEASON
item.description: NELLIS AIR FORCE BASE, NEVADA -- The United States Air Force Air Demonstration Squadron, known as the “Thunderbirds,” earned their final certification for the upcoming 2026 season from Gen. Adrian Spain, commander of Air Combat Command, March 5, 2026. Thursday’s certification affirms the team’s role in showcasing the unparalleled precision and professionalism that underpin all American airpower.

item.title: Fort McCoy hold Desert Storm History Day event recalling operation’s 35th anniversary
item.description: Fort McCoy honored the 35th anniversary of Operation Desert Storm on Feb. 26 with the Desert Storm History Day and Lunch and Learn at the Fort McCoy History Center in the historic Commemorative Area.

item.title: Behind Every Soldier’s Path: U.S. Army Pacific Hosts 2026 Career Counselor of the Year Competition
item.description: FORT SHAFTER, Hawaii– U.S. Army Pacific (USARPAC) kicked off its annual Career Counselor of the Year competition, March 2-6, 2026, bringing together top career counselors from across the Indo-Pacific to demonstrate their expertise, dedication, and vital role in guiding Soldiers through critical career decisions that strengthen readiness across the force.

item.title: Coast Guard Cutter Munro crew returns home after 119-day, multi-mission patrol; more than 20,000 pounds of cocaine seized
item.description: ALAMEDA, Calif. – The crew of U.S. Coast Guard Cutter Munro (WMSL 755) returned to their home port in Alameda, on Sunday, following a historic 119-day multi-mission deployment spanning more than 26,000 miles from the Eastern Pacific Ocean to the Northern Atlantic. item.title: Paraguayan President Santiago Peña visits SOUTHCOM
item.description: Paraguayan President Santiago Peña visited U.S. Southern Command (SOUTHCOM) March 6 and met with SOUTHCOM Commander Marine Gen. Francis L. Donovan as well as other command and Department of War leaders.

item.title: A New Era Begins: NCOLCoE Renamed United States Army Noncommissioned Officer Academy
item.description: In a significant move for the U.S. Army, the NCO Leadership Center of Excellence (NCOLCoE) at Fort Bliss, Texas, was officially renamed the United States Army Noncommissioned Officer Academy (USANCOA) on March 6, 2026. This event marks a strategic transformation to integrate the institution more fully into the Army's academic framework.
